invariants.rationale: Alignment constants such as Align#center, Align#top, etc., are typically defined as non-negative integers.

invariants.expression: align == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.center || align == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.top || align == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.bottom || align == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.left || align == com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.right || ((align & ~(com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.center | com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.top | com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.bottom | com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.left | com.badlogic.gdx.utils.Align.right)) == 0)
invariants.rationale: Valid alignments are individual constants or valid combinations of those bits.
Left and right can be combined or separate but not both unless intentional for combination masks.
Top and bottom can be combined for certain alignments, so this logic checks for meaningful combinations.
At least one alignment flag (center, left, right, top, or bottom) should be present.
